Strategy: Soft awkward-band avoidance. Exact fits score highest; residuals between a third of the item and the full item score modestly lower, while tighter and roomier residuals rank like Best Fit. The choice differs from Best Fit when the tightest fit falls in that awkward band while a looser bin can hold another item. It may help by steering away from awkward leftovers without overusing roomy bins, but may fail if the nudge is too weak to change the packing.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [1000.0 if r - item == 0 else (-(r - item) - 50.0 if r - item > item / 3 and r - item <= item else -(r - item)) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Soft awkward-band avoidance: penalize residual in (item/3, item] by 50, exact fit highest, else Best Fit.
